ul.li: UNIQUE (sequence_scope, sequence_number) on Ticket enforces the "no duplicate numbers" rule under either numbering scheme.

scope_key defers the open numbering question. Store '2026-07-15' for date-scoped numbering or '2026' for year-scoped. Switching schemes later is a config change plus a backfill — not a schema migration.
ticket_no is a persisted, generated value — never recomputed on read, so backdated rows keep their original number.
name_normalized (lower + trim + collapse whitespace) blocks duplicate employees created inline from the ticket form.

closed_at is separate from updated_at so the dashboard can count problems solved per period accurately. ongoing_at is set on first entry to Ongoing; a Closed ticket with ongoing_at IS NULL was fixed on the spot, which is what makes first-time fix rate measurable with no extra column.

row_key = the ticket_no. It locates the ticket's row in the sheet without depending on row position, which the sheet's newest-first ordering makes unreliable. raw_row_number is a cache of the row index in the append-only _raw tab, where rows never shift.
Index: tickets (date), tickets (status), tickets (assigned_to, status), tickets (closed_at), outbox (status, created_at).

There is no Voided status and no delete path. Encoding errors are corrected by editing; the audit log preserves the change. Deleting would gap the number sequence and orphan the row already sent to the sheet.
